INP_solution_data.note: Physical response dataset, not an electronic spin calculation; charge/multiplicity are reporting placeholders for this dataset object.

control_definitions.instantaneous: Memoryless phase proportional to intensity with the measured beam/instrument-response convolution.
control_definitions.thermal: Heat equation or explicitly justified reduced diffusion response driven by absorbed power alpha, path length and beam radius. Share material parameters across conditions.
control_definitions.mixed: Sum of electronic and thermal contributions under the same calibration. Parameter profiles may establish a non-identifiable range.
control_definitions.validation: Hold out one measured power/concentration/time condition before fitting; never use author fitted tau as held-out raw data.

observable_definition: All three physical models share the same measured observation rows, concentration/path-length/absorption/beam definitions and measurement uncertainty. Fit data and held-out conditions are disjoint; no synthetic or interpolated points count as measurements.

experimental_conditions.thermal_parameters: Missing calibrated source/prior ranges; not invented
experimental_conditions.source: Main PDF p3, p9, Figures6/9/10; SI p7 S8

required_comparisons.description: Same-data constrained comparison of three physical models
Identifiability, history dependence and held-out prediction

optional_not_scored: Molecular DFT, PMMA-film modeling and optical limiter performance are optional.
input_blockers: Figure 10 now has 27 traceable discrete temporal marker rows with pixel-reading bounds. Independent power/intensity and Z-scan measurement rows from the remaining figures, with defensible experimental/digitization errors, remain missing. Fitted curves and fitted time constants are not independent observations.

The available source text does not establish a complete calibrated SSPM beam-waist, instrument-response and thermal-parameter dataset. Obtain measurement/plot digitization with bounded parameter provenance before completing model discrimination.
source_note: Molecular identities, benchmark-defined starts and explicitly labelled measured observations are authorized inputs. Graph provenance identifies chemical identity only; state labels, optimized added geometries and predicted outputs are withheld. See task.md for the common scientific scope.
public_private_boundary: Identity/connectivity and declared measured observations are public. Author optimized new candidate geometries, computed rankings, reference outputs and legacy PASS archives are private.
